The short version

If you only read one line

Riding alone, want the best of it

Ather 450X. If the budget stretches and you want the quickest thing on the road, 450 Apex.

Riding alone, watching the budget

Ather 450S. Same motor and chassis as the 450X, different screen.

Pillion, children or luggage

Ather Rizta Z. 56 litres of storage, flat floorboard, backrest as standard.

Family scooter, lowest price

Ather Rizta S. Everything practical about the Rizta Z, minus the touchscreen.
